mentions.name: Mesh
mentions.description: A middle-grade sci-fi thriller novel about a broke kid who wins a spot at a high-tech genius school, discovers the flagship 'cool' project is actually mind control for the whole world, and must out-hack teachers, drones, and a traitor friend using only his brain, DIY skills, and the outlaw Mesh. The story features gadgets, pranks, and chases while prompting readers to consider what they would do if adults tried to control every thought in their head. It is in final edits, with plans to seek a literary agent and a publishing deal by the end of 2026.
